verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe connecting OneDrive, Outlook.com (email/calendar/contacts), Google Drive, and Gmail/Calendar/Contacts, with concrete example queries for finding files, emails, and calendar events (copilot-docs-7/13/19/25, 8/14/20, 21/26, 22/27). Community evidence (copilot-comm-7) corroborates cross-document data fetching works well, and no evidence specifically contradicts connector search failing. Missing for 10: independent hands-on testing specifically of the connector search feature (vs. general Office Copilot complaints), and clarity on how broadly this applies across all Copilot surfaces (copilot-comm-1 notes it's scoped to the standalone Copilot app/site, not Office 365 integration).
